note: flags from an independent visual reviewer who looked at the compare images

flags.problem: Centre-field 'P' logo reads as a soft white smear at 1:1 instead of crisp painted lettering; grass otherwise matches the aerial turf.
flags.fix: Keep the logo region from the upscaled original (or sharpen just that mask) so the P has crisp edges; leave the grass injection as is.

flags.problem: 1:1 crop looks smoky and mushy; gate seam_out 0.93 vs seam_orig 0.1 means the tiling wrap edges likely got worse.
flags.fix: Re-run with seam-aware wrap (blend or offset-check the edges so left/right and top/bottom match) and reduce the moss injection blur so canopy speckle stays crisp at 1:1.

flags.problem: Dark halo and ringing fringes along the white '4' strokes in the shrunk and 1:1 views; edges look blurred/bubbly rather than the original's crisp pixel-stepped glyph.
flags.fix: Remove the overshoot from the back-projection step, clamping output to the local min/max of the source 16x16 neighbourhood, so strokes have no dark rim; keep the glyph silhouette unchanged.

flags.problem: 1:1 crop is soft: window frames and brick courses are smeared and the roofline edges blur into the magenta matte; gate tileable_guess is false so no wrap issue, but the detail is mushy.
flags.fix: Sharpen brick and window edges with the brick-inject pass at the source scale (or cap the colormatch blur), and confirm the magenta lower band is an intended key colour rather than a fill that leaked into the RGB.
